# teamctl

> Provider-agnostic AI agent teams on plain tmux: a lead agent manages
> teammates (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini — or any CLI via a custom
> provider block) as panes. Headless dispatch with JSON results,
> exact-session follow-ups, per-teammate git-worktree isolation with a
> land step, quota-aware routing, teammate status detection, and a roster
> that survives reboots. Single-file Python, stdlib only, tmux is the
> only runtime dependency. Current release: v0.5.0.

Core rule you will meet everywhere: teamctl refuses instead of guessing —
exact session or refusal, ask instead of silently picking a provider,
keep-and-report instead of discarding work, "unknown" stated as unknown.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): the full human-facing tour — install, quickstart,
  worktrees + landing, routing, lead mode, configuration, security notes,
  honest limitations.
- [docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md](docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): the agent-facing operational
  contract — command reference, every --json surface, the lead playbook,
  worktree lifecycle, custom-provider schema with a worked example.
- [docs/INSTALL_PROMPT.md](docs/INSTALL_PROMPT.md): the paste-into-your-agent
  install prompt (a pointer, not a manual).

## Install

- One-liner: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryderderder/teamctl/main/install.sh | bash`
- Agent-driven: paste docs/INSTALL_PROMPT.md into any AI coding CLI.
- Verify with `teamctl doctor` (exit 0 ok / 1 warn / 2 fail).

## Source

- [teamctl](teamctl): the entire tool — one Python file. Provider behavior
  lives in the PROVIDER_SPECS registry near the top; users extend it via
  [providers.custom.*] config blocks, no code changes.
- [install.sh](install.sh): installer (records its source so
  `teamctl update` works; detects WSL and greets it as supported Linux).
- [tests/](tests/): 419 tests — run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`
  inside a tmux session to include the live pane tier.
